payload.title: Vehicle Builder Socket Prep UX / 차량 메시 소켓 준비 UX
payload.next_action: VSPUX-P0-02: implement independent Recipe-free Quick Socket Prep in existing Builder Tab. Here 'location' specifically refers to Hardpoint LOCATION CATEGORY such as Top/Front/LeftSide, NOT 3D socket coordinate. Current supported categories count seven but are extensible. Populate category selection dynamically from existing FCFVehicleBuilderVM::GetStandardHardpointCategories/StandardHardpointCategories; apply same category-agnostic HP_<Category>_<NN> naming/max+1/parser and downstream Recipe/consumer contract. No per-category fixed UI branch or fixed count assumption. Do not enable arbitrary new category in runtime by Quick UI alone: future formal categories require same semantic unit integration review. Retain current Wheel role/Step1-8/Recipe, existing Socket inventory/reopen and Quick refresh/return, no automatic save or transform changes; focused validation and UE 5.8 Source Build follow in P0-03. All implementation and tests remain Not Run.

provenance.resolution_basis: User explicitly corrected that position means Hardpoint semantic category Top/Front/LeftSide, not relative coordinate, and emphasized category extensibility. Source shows current seven categories in StandardHardpointCategories() and parser accepts caller category array. Plan v0.1.3 states latest authoritative interpretation and removes coordinate-view UX from required scope; previous 2026-10-14 coordinate-centric review is historical. Design/document only; no source, UE asset, build, tests, git stage/commit/push.
